fields.label: Use values from input file
fields.help: Check this box to use values from an input file.

fields.label: AERMOD Deposition File
fields.help: Indicate the AERMOD plotfile (.PLT) output file. It must use the same geographic extent and meteorological scenario being modeled in pyTRIM. It must contain wet and dry deposition estimates.

fields.label: Spacing
fields.help: For the receptors in the AERMOD deposition file, indicate whether they are uniformly spaced or non-uniformly spaced.

fields.label: Coordinate System
fields.help: Select the system for coordinate value pairs provided in your PLT file.

fields.label: UTM Zone
fields.help: Enter the default UTM zone number/letter for the coordinate values in your PLT file; e.g., "16N".

fields.label: Description of Coordinate System
fields.help: Enter the coordinate system of X and Y coordinates you provided in your text or CSV file. Typical options include WGS 1984 or NAD 1983 for latitude/longitude, and UTM zones for metric X and Y coordinates. If you provided a shapefile instead of a text or CSV file, the coordinate system will be automatically detected and displayed here.
